fields.title: Greeting
fields.content: Hello! Thank you for contacting support. How can I assist you today?

fields.title: Acknowledgement
fields.content: Thank you for reaching out. I have received your request and will investigate. Please allow up to 24 hours for a response.

fields.title: Issue Resolved
fields.content: I am glad to inform you that your issue has been resolved. If you experience any further problems, please do not hesitate to contact us again. Have a great day!

fields.title: Offer Verification Request
fields.content:
To verify your offer completion, please provide:
1. Offer name
2. Click ID (if available)
3. Screenshot of completion
4. Date/time when you completed the offer

fields.title: Withdrawal Information Request
fields.content:
To investigate your withdrawal, please provide:
1. Transaction ID
2. Amount requested
3. Payment method (bKash/Nagad/Bank)
4. Account number used
5. Date of request
